question.text: Per SEBI Circular dated June 30, 2020, RTAs collect stamp duty on:

answer.text: Issue, transfer and sale of units of AIFs

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 4.2.2, RTAs act as 'collecting agents' for stamp duty on issue, transfer and sale of AIF units. The Trap: Other transactions don't invoke stamp duty through RTAs. Cross-Exam Context: Amendment to Indian Stamp Act 1899. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Audit stamp-duty collection quarterly to prevent cumulative shortfalls.
